A bite of mountain taste in the heart of Hanoi
Aug 2024 • Friends
In the heart of Hanoi, you can cross a door and being projected in a place far away from the crowded streets of this beautiful town. Here you can taste a bite of the northern cosine, finally something different from the week known Pho. Dish selection is amazing, but many are either seasonal, or pre-order ones, hence remember to ask. Service is very professional and super kind. Price are more then honest and affordable. My suggestion: don't miss it if you're looking for genuine taste
